job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a leading Cayman Islands organisation for a Software Engineer to join its Innovation Team. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced developer to design, build and support secure digital solutions spanning artificial intelligence, workflow automation, full-stack web development, cloud technologies, reporting and analytics.

You will work across a varied technology stack, helping to develop AI-enabled and cloud-native solutions while collaborating with both technical and business teams in an Agile environment.

Company Information

This opportunity is with an established and highly regarded Cayman Islands-based organisation with a diverse business portfolio and a strong focus on technology, innovation and digital transformation.

You will join a collaborative Innovation Team responsible for developing modern digital solutions that improve business processes and support wider organisational objectives. The environment offers exposure to enterprise-scale technology, AI, Microsoft platforms and Azure, with an emphasis on continuous learning and professional development.

Responsibilities and Duties

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, test and deploy AI agents, workflow automations, full-stack web applications, reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Develop enterprise AI solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry and other AI technologies, following responsible AI principles.
  • Build cloud-native web applications and REST APIs using C#, TypeScript, Node.js, React and Microsoft Azure services.
  • Automate business processes using Power Automate, integrating solutions with Microsoft 365, Dataverse, Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems.
  • Evaluate, test and monitor AI solutions for accuracy, grounding, safety, performance and cost, resolving issues within production environments.
  • Deploy and operate solutions on Azure using DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, automated testing and monitoring.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Work within Agile teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality solutions iteratively.

Qualifications and Skills

You should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • A minimum of three years' progressive software engineering experience, including experience across the full software development lifecycle.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry, alongside Power Automate development and integration.
  • Strong full-stack development experience using C#, .NET Core, REST APIs, TypeScript, Node.js and React.
  • A good understanding of object-oriented design patterns and SOLID principles, with experience working with layered, service-based or hexagonal architectures.
  • Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL or MySQL; exposure to NoSQL solutions such as Azure Cosmos DB would be advantageous.
  • Experience with Azure cloud services, DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and monitoring.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

Benefits and Perks

The successful candidate will receive a competitive package designed to support your wellbeing, career development and long-term growth, including:

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance premium for the employee.
  • Employee and employer pension contributions.
  • Life insurance and long-term disability coverage, subject to applicable conditions.
  • Enhanced annual leave provisions, including vacation and personal days.
  • Maternity and paternity leave benefits.
  • A dedicated wellness screening day.
  • Continuing professional development opportunities following successful completion of the six-month probationary period.

This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position offering the opportunity to work with modern AI, cloud and Microsoft technologies while contributing to meaningful digital transformation projects in the Cayman Islands.

job.title: Software Engineer

job.title: Audit Director - Digital Assets
job.description:
About the Company:
This firm has an excellent reputation on island and a growing digital assets practice. Clients include crypto and digital asset funds, virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and tokenised fund structures.

About the Opportunity:
This is a standout Audit Director opportunity for an existing Director working in digital assets. You'll lead a portfolio of digital asset audits from planning through to sign-off, and you'll be the main point of contact for clients, fund administrators and regulators. CIMA now licenses virtual asset custodians and trading platforms, and stricter auditor approval rules start in January 2027. That means experienced digital asset audit leaders are in high demand on island. If you want senior responsibility in one of the fastest-growing areas of Cayman financial services, along with a genuine work-life balance, competitive salary and a supportive team culture, don't miss this role. Director roles in this niche are rare, so apply now for full details.

About You:

  • Fully qualified auditor (CA, CPA, SAICA, ACCA, etc.) and a current Audit Director with a specialism in digital assets (essential)
  • Ideally already licensed as a CIIPA practitioner member in Cayman, or eligible to get licensed on arrival
  • At least 5 years of management-level experience auditing regulated financial institutions, including digital asset funds, custodians, exchanges or trading platforms
  • Hands-on experience auditing:
  • existence and ownership of digital assets, including wallet and private key controls and blockchain confirmations
  • custody arrangements and SOC reports
  • valuation of illiquid tokens
  • IT and cyber controls
  • Good working knowledge of the Virtual Asset (Service Providers) Act, CIMA's VASP regime and AML/CFT requirements, plus audit obligations under the Mutual Funds and Private Funds Acts
  • Great interpersonal skills with clients and internal stakeholders, and a proven track record of training and developing your team in a positive, fun culture

The culture encourages knowledge sharing, professional development, and the adoption of industry best practices.

Responsibilities and Duties

As a Cloud Microservices Developer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable microservices using modern development frameworks and best practices.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs, with exposure to GraphQL or gRPC where required.
  • Develop and deploy cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform environments.
  • Create and manage containerised applications using Docker and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes or managed cloud services.
  • Implement event-driven architectures and integrate systems using messaging and streaming technologies including Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS/SNS, or EventBridge.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines, improving deployment efficiency and reliability.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise application performance, scalability, availability, and resource utilisation.
  • Produce technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and support ongoing platform enhancement and incident resolution.

Qualifications and Skills

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 2 to 5 years of experience developing enterprise-level software applications.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience building and implementing microservices-based solutions.
  • Strong experience with Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, Go, Python, or similar modern programming languages.
  • Practical knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD tools, and automated testing methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of API security standards including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT authentication.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and analytical skills, with experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban.

Desirable Skills

The following would be advantageous:

  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Hexagonal Architecture, or Clean Architecture.
  • Apache Kafka and event-driven architecture experience.
  • Service Mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Observability and monitoring tools including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Kubernetes certifications.

Benefits and Perks

In return for your expertise, you can expect:

  • Competitive salary package.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cloud and microservices technologies.
  • Exposure to large-scale, business-critical cloud platforms and distributed systems.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Ongoing professional development and training opportunities.
  • Career progression within a growing technology function.
  • Participation in innovative projects that drive digital transformation.
  • A culture that values continuous learning, technical excellence, and employee growth.
